facts.fact: Smith 对两项谋杀不认罪，被还押候审。
facts.anchor: He’d already pleaded not guilty to two counts of murder. Been remanded in custody to await the course of justice.

facts.fact: Kate 犹豫是否出庭旁听。
facts.anchor: Kate remained in two minds about whether to attend court.

facts.fact: Smith 1998–2001 在利兹读英语，大二与 Emily 同住底层公寓。
facts.anchor: studied English in Leeds from 1998 to 2001. In his second year, he lived on Otley Road, sharing a ground-floor flat with Emily Pierce.

facts.fact: 警方在他沿乡间小路逃跑时将其抓获。
facts.anchor: They picked Smith up as he ran down the dark country lane.

facts.fact: Alice 说与 Matty、Emily、Jake 同住是她人生最糟的几个月。
facts.anchor: about living with Matty Smith, Emily Pierce and Jake Jeffreyes. How it had been the worst few months of her life.

facts.fact: Alice 与 Gareth 回公寓时发现 Emily 的尸体。
facts.anchor: Alice told Kate about finding Emily’s body when she returned to the flat with her friend (now partner) Gareth

facts.fact: 监控拍到他在 King’s Cross 与利兹站厅，相隔两个半小时。
facts.anchor: caught on CCTV at London King’s Cross station and on the station concourse at Leeds, two and a half hours later.

facts.fact: Aiden 在 Olivia 被杀当天有不止一个不在场证明。
facts.anchor: He had more than one alibi for the day she was killed

facts.fact: Jake 在控方证人名单上。
facts.anchor: Mr Jeffreyes was on the list of prosecution witnesses.

facts.fact: Kate 决定把整件事从头到尾写下来。
facts.anchor: she would write the whole thing down from start to finish

facts.fact: 她把两颗星当作 Emily 与 Olivia。
facts.anchor: She told herself one was Emily, the other Olivia.
